formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the signer's (owner's) USDS allowance for the spender to exactly `value`. It replaces any earlier allowance and does not add to it (Usds.sol permit: allowance[owner][spender] = value).
The signature can only be used up to `deadline` (require(block.timestamp <= deadline)).
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce (nonces[owner]++).
If `value` is type(uint256).max, the allowance never goes down when the spender uses it (transferFrom skips the decrement), so the spender can pull USDS without limit.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens" with the spender (raw address), the max spending amount in USDS ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or more), the valid-until date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line names no token, amount or spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json format Permit(...): "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens", and there is no interpolatedIntent. The amount, spender and deadline appear only as fields.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
